summary: Don't parse CLI text when the device has a REST API returning JSON, existing facts modules return the data, or resource modules manage that config.
questions: When should I avoid parsing CLI output?
Should I use cli_parse if my device has a REST API?

answer_card.title: When not to parse CLI text
answer_card.answer_md:
Skip parsing when:
- the device has a REST API that returns JSON
- existing facts modules already return the data
- network resource modules already manage that configuration
